تعلولون (form XII)
# تَعْلَوْلُونَ (taʕlawlūna) /taʕ.law.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# تُعْلَوْلَوْنَ (tuʕlawlawna) /tuʕ.law.law.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
